span.p:
API Gateway
spammer 5,000 link / sec
-> gateway pe har user / IP ki ginti + login, had paar = 429 (rate limit)
aage WAF: pehchaane hamle wahin rok (WAF)
kai gateway -> ginti ek jagah (shared Redis)
had paar -> 429, asli users bache
bot naya IP -> ginti API key pe
chhota karne se pehle -> lamba URL check (virus / dhokha)
